plugins.name: council-dial-lite
plugins.description: The lighter, script-free edition of Council Dial. Runs a review council of Claude subagents the way you choose, with read-only agents by default. Claude saves each agent's report itself, copies the findings word for word into a summary a fresh agent checks, and logs each run. A council can flag an rm -rf that could delete the wrong data, as well as bugs, security issues and wrong docs, but may miss some; for research runs, use the full Council Dial: https://github.com/Ablation-Lab/council-dial.
